name: Pine Island Reserve
reason: Murrumbidgee riverside reserve named by the ACT parks agency (relied on parks-act-leads) and VisitCanberra, plus two Wikivoyage pages, with swimming, fishing and kayaking; second-tier nature stop (rule 1, 2).
objection: A small picnic reserve; a half-hour stop for most.

name: Murrumbidgee Discovery Track
reason: 27 km track named by VisitCanberra and the ACT parks agency (two counted sources); a walk a guide promotes (rule 1, 2). Pine Island is a separate place at one end.
objection: No Wikipedia article or coordinates; the full length is rated hard and the route may overlap other candidates.

name: Southern Cross Stadium
reason: Indoor sports stadium with no tour or museum named (run rule: stadiums; rule 2).
objection: Wikivoyage lists it.

name: Viking Park
reason: Sports stadium with no tour or museum named (run rule: stadiums; rule 2).
objection: Wikivoyage lists it.

name: Lakeside Leisure Centre
reason: Public leisure centre: a local sports facility, not a visitor draw (rule 2).
objection: It is on the lake and listed in Wikivoyage.

name: Limelight Cinemas Tuggeranong
reason: Commercial cinema in a shopping centre (run rule: cinemas; rule 2).
objection: Wikivoyage lists it.

name: Metaphysica
reason: A retail shop (rule 2).
objection: None.

name: Murrumbidgee Country Club
reason: Golf club; a business/club, not a place to visit (run rule).
objection: Two Wikivoyage pages list it and it is open to public bookings.

name: Tharwa Village
reason: Wikivoyage Country ACT gives it its own listing: oldest settlement in the ACT, old Murrumbidgee bridge, pottery, gateway to Namadgi (run rule: Hall and Tharwa kept). Opened Wikivoyage Country_ACT.
objection: Small, declining village; one source and a short visit.

name: Historic Glenburn Homestead
reason: Wikivoyage Airport and East lists it as a heritage precinct open 24 hours with 1830s structures, ruins, gravesites and farm machinery; a historic homestead with things to see (run rule). Opened that page.
objection: Single source; a ruin-style site in a pine forest, described in effusive language; short visit.

name: Sparrow Hill and East Kowen Forest Trails
reason: Wikivoyage names the trailhead for mountain biking and hiking in a pine plantation (rule 1), a legitimate activity place.
objection: One source; a commercial plantation trail network, not a distinct landmark; Kowen Forest may be better covered by another candidate.

name: Molonglo Gorge Nature Reserve
reason: Wikivoyage Airport and East describes a signposted 15 km river-gorge reserve with a main recreation area (run rule: named nature reserve kept). Opened that page.
objection: Single source; day-use gorge with a short visit.

name: Pialligo Redwood Forest
reason: Wikivoyage lists it open 24 hours: Walter Burley Griffin's redwood planting, a heritage forest to walk through (rule 1, 2). Opened that page.
objection: Single source; a stand of trees beside the airport runway, short visit.

name: Lindsay Pryor National Arboretum
reason: Wikivoyage Woden lists it twice (Woden and Weston Creek pages): lakeside arboretum good for autumn colour and a stroll (rule 1, 2).
objection: Wikivoyage itself notes poor maintenance, it is the former arboretum, and it is near-duplicate in kind to the National Arboretum; a stroll only.

name: STEP Botanic Garden
reason: Part of the National Arboretum precinct (part of a larger spot; rule 3).
objection: Named separately on Wikivoyage.

name: Himalayan Cedars
reason: A grove inside the National Arboretum: part of National Arboretum (rule 3).
objection: A winter highlight.

name: Dairy Farmers Hill
reason: A lookout hill inside the National Arboretum: part of National Arboretum (rule 3).
objection: Two counted sources name it as a viewpoint.

name: National Bonsai and Penjing Collection
reason: A collection inside the National Arboretum's Village Centre: part of National Arboretum (rule 3); keep the larger.
objection: Two counted sources, free entry and a real draw in its own right.

name: National Rock Garden
reason: A display within the National Arboretum precinct: part of National Arboretum (rule 3).
objection: Named on Wikivoyage.

name: Yarramundi Reach
reason: Riverside reach next to the Lindsay Pryor arboretum, with nothing a source names to see beyond it (part of that area; rule 3).
objection: Wikivoyage has its own subsection for it.

name: Stromlo Cottage
reason: Wikivoyage Woden and the Weston Creek page both list a 1926 heritage cottage that tells Canberra's story (two counted sources). Opened Woden page.
objection: Wikivoyage entry dates from 2022 and gives no hours or confirmation that it is open to visit; a small suburban cottage.

name: Stromlo Leisure Centre
reason: Local indoor sports centre (rule 2).
objection: Listed in Wikivoyage.

name: Phillip Swimming and Ice Skating Centre
reason: Local swimming and skating centre, a sports facility (rule 2).
objection: Ice skating is unusual for a visitor.

name: Eddison Park
reason: Local community park that no guide singles out (run rule).
objection: Listed in Wikivoyage.

name: Escape Rooms Canberra
reason: Commercial escape-room business (run rule).
objection: None.

name: Timezone Woden
reason: Commercial amusement arcade in a mall (rule 2).
objection: None.

name: HOYTS Woden
reason: Commercial cinema (run rule).
objection: None.

name: Endota Spa Woden
reason: Commercial day spa (rule 2).
objection: VisitCanberra lists it.

name: Yoga Paws
reason: A class operator, not a place (rule 2).
objection: VisitCanberra lists it.

name: POD Playground at the National Arboretum
reason: A playground within the National Arboretum: part of a larger spot (rule 3).
objection: Two VisitCanberra pages name it.

name: Nature Play at the Arboretum
reason: A recurring program, not a permanent place (rule 4).
objection: None.

name: National Arboretum Welcome Walks
reason: A guided tour at the Arboretum, not a place (rule 2, 3).
objection: Free and daily.

name: National Library of Australia
reason: National institution (run rule) with 3 counted sources: Wikivoyage, VisitCanberra museums and attractions; main reading room, exhibitions and free tours.
objection: A library is a civic building by default; it qualifies only through the exhibitions and tours.

name: Museum of Australian Democracy
reason: Duplicate of Old Parliament House (same building; run rule).
objection: Two VisitCanberra sources use this name.

name: Australian War Memorial
reason: Canberra's flagship national museum and memorial, five counted sources, free entry, daily Last Post ceremony.
objection: None worth noting; a possible duplicate with Anzac Parade as a place, but it is a distinct institution.

name: Government House
reason: Residence seen only from a lookout off the road (exterior only; run rule).
objection: Wikivoyage names it and some visitors take the photo stop.

name: The Lodge
reason: Prime Minister's residence seen from outside only (run rule).
objection: Wikivoyage lists it and it is a recognisable Canberra icon.

name: Calthorpes' House
reason: Historic house with guided tours (Sat Sun 1-4pm, $7), four counted sources including VisitCanberra and the three-house pass. Opened Wikivoyage South Canberra.
objection: Open only weekends afternoons; small house; the part-of signal came from the three-house pass but each house is a separate place.

name: National Capital Exhibition
reason: Free exhibition on Canberra's planning and history at Regatta Point; two counted sources (Wikivoyage North Canberra, VisitCanberra).
objection: Small indoor exhibition near the visitors centre; short visit.

name: Canberra and Region Visitors Centre
reason: A visitor-information office, not an attraction (rule 2).
objection: Shares Regatta Point with the National Capital Exhibition.

name: Manuka Pool
reason: Wikivoyage South Canberra lists an art deco 1930 pool; heritage character and a swim (rule 2). Opened that page.
objection: Open only late October to mid-March; one source; essentially a local pool.

name: Kingston Foreshore Redevelopment
reason: A dining and apartment precinct whose draws are cafes and a weekend market (rule 2, 4).
objection: VisitCanberra names it and it offers boat hire on the lake.
